name: keepit-msp-mcp
description: Keepit-MCP is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for the Keepit REST API.
long_description:
**Keepit Extension**
This extension provides a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for interacting with the Keepit REST API.

**What's Available Now (Read-Only)**
* **Account Information**: View account status, product details, and subscription information
* **Monitor Connectors**: View health status and list of backup connectors for each service
* **View Backup Jobs**: Check active jobs, history, and details of backup operations across all workloads
* **Browse Snapshots**: Explore available backup snapshots and query by time range
* **Audit Log History**: Review audit log events for a given time period

**What's Coming Later**
* **Backup Management**: Schedule and configure backup jobs
* **Restore Operations**: Perform restores with granular control over what gets restored
* **Resource Management**: Track usage, compliance, and billing
* **Anomaly Detection**: Get alerts on backup issues and irregularities

**Configuration**
The extension requires Keepit API credentials which can be configured through user settings.

tools.name: get_account_info
tools.description: Get a compact summary for one account. Best for a quick tenant/client overview before drilling into MFA, SSO, usage, or connectors.

tools.name: get_account_contact_info
tools.description: Get the authoritative primary contact details for one account.

tools.name: get_account_mfa_status
tools.description: Get account-level MFA status and configured MFA factors for one account.

tools.name: get_account_sso_status
tools.description: Get account-level SSO status and SSO configuration details for one account.

tools.name: get_account_usage_summary
tools.description: Get a period-based usage summary for one account. Use this for historical usage over a date range.

tools.name: get_account_current_usage
tools.description: Get current usage for one account. Use this for the latest point-in-time usage snapshot.

tools.name: get_account_resource_usage
tools.description: Get per-resource usage details for one account.

tools.name: get_user_mfa_status
tools.description: Get per-user MFA status for a specific user.

tools.name: list_account_users
tools.description: List user principals associated with one account.

tools.name: list_account_tokens
tools.description: List secondary account tokens for one account.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: List accounts in scope. Use this to discover valid account IDs before calling more specific account or MSP tools.

tools.name: list_sub_accounts
tools.description: List direct sub-accounts for one account.

tools.name: find_account
tools.description: Find accounts by partial name, external ID, or account ID within the requested scope.

tools.name: get_account_summary
tools.description: Get a richer single-account summary including connectors and recent audit events. Use this when a quick overview is not enough.

tools.name: get_account_security_summary
tools.description: Get a focused single-account security summary covering areas such as MFA, SSO, and related posture indicators.

tools.name: get_account_token_summary
tools.description: Get a focused summary of secondary tokens for one account.

tools.name: get_account_connector_summary
tools.description: Get a focused summary of connectors for one account.

tools.name: get_msp_overview
tools.description: Get a high-level overview across all accounts in the requested scope. Use this for broad MSP rollups, not single-account detail.

tools.name: get_msp_security_overview
tools.description: Get a high-level security overview across all accounts in the requested scope.

tools.name: get_msp_usage_overview
tools.description: Get a period-based MSP usage overview across all accounts in the requested scope.

tools.name: get_msp_current_usage_overview
tools.description: Get a current MSP usage overview across all accounts in the requested scope.

tools.name: get_msp_workload_usage_summary
tools.description: Get a period-based MSP workload usage summary across all accounts in the requested scope.

tools.name: get_msp_current_workload_usage_summary
tools.description: Get a current MSP workload usage summary across all accounts in the requested scope.

tools.name: get_msp_connector_summary
tools.description: Get a focused MSP connector summary across all accounts in the requested scope.

tools.name: get_active_jobs
tools.description: Get a list of active jobs, including their statuses and creation dates

tools.name: get_job_history
tools.description: Get a list of backup and/or restore jobs for a connector

tools.name: get_cloud_connectors
tools.description: List connectors in the requested account scope. Use this to discover connector GUIDs before calling health or summary tools. When account_id is omitted, the default scope is the authenticated/root account plus its direct child accounts.

tools.name: find_connector
tools.description: Find connectors across the requested account scope using a partial or exact name or GUID. Use this when you know part of the connector name but not the GUID.

tools.name: get_connector_health
tools.description: Get the health status for exactly one connector. Provide either guid or connector_name, not both. If connector_name could match multiple connectors, call find_connector first to resolve the GUID.

tools.name: get_audit_log_history
tools.description: Get raw audit log events for one account or an account scope. Prefer scope "account" for a single tenant/client. Responses return at most 500 records per request window. Offset continuation is supported for single-account queries only.

tools.name: get_audit_log_summary
tools.description: Get an aggregated audit summary for one account or an account scope. Use this when you want trends, counts, top actors, or top messages rather than raw events. For single-tenant questions, prefer scope "account".

tools.name: get_latest_snapshot
tools.description: Get the timestamp of the most recent completed snapshot for a connector

tools.name: get_snapshot_range
tools.description: Get a list of snapshots for a connector within a given time range

prompts.name: backup_status
prompts.description: Check the current backup status and any recent job failures
prompts.text: Please show me the current backup status and any recent job failures. Use the get_active_jobs and get_job_history tools to provide a comprehensive overview.

prompts.name: connector_health
prompts.description: Check the health status of all backup connectors and report any issues
prompts.text: Check the health status of all my backup connectors using get_cloud_connectors and get_connector_health tools. Report any issues or anomalies found.
